purpose: Require actual native-4K motion evidence before Temporal/LOD/aliasing stability or the shimmer/LOD critical-defect checks can be cleared.

probes.reason: A 24 mm total lateral camera translation at the grazing-light benchmark exposes subpixel instability on sash, rail, antenna, foliage edges and material microdetail without changing the underlying scene state.

A 40 m far-to-near sweep around the oblique benchmark spans a large projected-size range so 4-level building, furniture and vegetation LOD systems can be reviewed for distracting transitions, silhouette discontinuity and shimmer.

notes: A sealed sequence proves only that Unity produced the referenced native frames; it does not prove that shimmer or LOD pop is absent.
Review frames at 100% pixel scale in order; do not use interpolated playback or rescaled crops to dismiss instability.
The still hero/oblique/grazing captures remain mandatory for the other eight categories and spatial aliasing evidence.

hardRules: Both probe sequences must be produced by the same Unity project scene and coherent midsummer lighting state used by the 4K benchmark pipeline.
Every frame must be 3840x2160 and every review crop must copy source texels 1:1 with zero resampling.
A temporal evidence reference is invalid unless its capture session, manifest SHA-256, receipt SHA-256 and every frame/crop hash validate.
The Temporal/LOD/aliasing category cannot pass its hard minimum from still frames alone.
severe_aliasing_or_shimmer cannot be marked absent without subpixel_grazing and lod_walk_oblique review.
visible_lod_pop cannot be marked absent without lod_walk_oblique review.
No temporal capture or source-side heuristic awards Visual Fidelity points automatically.
